title: DE-4/2022/A6 DEPARTMENTAL EXAMINATION FOR JUNIOR MEMBERS OF I.A.S., I.P.S. AND I.F.S. - DECEMBER, 2021 - Division 'C' (Higher Standard) REVENUE AND OTHER LAWS [with books - 150, without books - 50]
questions: PART A (with books) 1. Explain the nature and consequence of "suspension" under the Kerala Civil Service (Classification Control and Appeal Rules, 1960).
2. How does the Kerala Forest Act, 1961 provide for preservation of wild elephants ?
3. Explain "disaster" and "disaster management". Discuss the major measures that can be taken by the Central Government for disaster management.
4. Distinguish between "contaminant" and "food additive". What constitutes "misbranded food" ?
5. What are the conditions to be taken into consideration for granting promotion under the Kerala State and Subordinate Service Rules, 1958 ? Explain the significance of "Select List".
6. How does the Kerala Agricultural Workers Act, 1974 regulate hours of work and wages of agricultural workers ? Explain the mechanism for settlement of agricultural disputes under the Act.
7. Examine the provisions for assessment and levy of basic tax under the Kerala Land Tax Act, 1961.
8. What are the grounds for eviction of a tenant under the Kerala Buildings (Lease and Rent Control) Act, 1965 ?
9. Define "public revenue due on land" under the Kerala Revenue Recovery Act, 1968. Discuss the procedure for attachment and sale of movable property under the Act.

10. Discuss the types of taxes and duties that can be levied by municipalities under Kerala Municipalities Act, 1994. Describe the classes of property tax that can be levied and the method for assessment. When can vacancy remission be granted ?

11. Elucidate the qualifications and disqualifications for being chosen as a member of panchayat under the Kerala Panchayats Act, 1994. What are the grounds for declaring an election to panchayat void under the Act ?
12. Explain the provisions of Motor Vehicles Act, 1988, regulating third part insurance. Describe the special provisions governing compensation in hit and run motor accidents.

13. Who is an "Illegal migrant" under the Indian Citizenship Act, 1955 ? Distinguish between citizenship by registration and citizenship by naturalisation. Discuss the ways in which citizenship can be terminated.

14. How does the Essential Commodities Act, 1955 empower the Central Government to control the production, supply and distribution of essential commodities ? Explain the grounds and procedure for confiscation of essential commodity.
PART B (without books) 15. Discuss the principles regulating determination of "Tariff" under the Indian Electricity Act, 2003.
16. Who is consumer under the Consumer Protection Act, 1986 ? Describe the composition and jurisdiction of the consumer Dispute Redressal Agencies established under the Act.
17. Explain the national and state level agencies for disaster management and their mechanism of action contemplated under the Disaster Management Act, 2005.

18. Elucidate the procedure and conditions for acquisition of requisitioned property under the Requisitioning and Acquisition of Immovable property Act, 1952. Explain the principles and method for determining compensation for requisitioned or acquired property under the Act.
